best_idea: Run the title screen as an AI-vs-AI fight on the same fight code, with no payout and no ledger write, and reset after each KO in a new random arena, so the menu always shows a live fight without touching a player's record.
decision_why: The attract fight is one step with two brains, and its early return before any ledger write matches our one-ledger ruling; the first-visit flag is client-only and stays on the client.
acceptance: The title screen shows AI-vs-AI fights; after a KO the next fight starts after 2.4 s in a new arena with three obstacles; after three attract fights the player's wins, losses and gold are unchanged (a server test compares the ledger before and after).
